name: grimmsnarl_ml_v25
policy: The measured v22 runtime retrained on 120 current same-deck AlphaTCG games and conditioned on that 1095.3-rated pilot. No v24 Froslass veto and no unvalidated search override.

policy_escalation.reason: The old Froslass class switch must remain inert after moving the global pilot pin from code 0 to code 3.

design_rationale: Logged outcomes identify only the chosen trajectory, so they cannot provide unbiased Q targets for unchosen actions.
The same-deck top pilot's actions encode multi-turn exchange judgement and can be learned without counterfactual target leakage.
Prior v7/v12 search stopped before the opponent response or used a local arithmetic leaf and did not pass ladder validation.
known_limits: Offline action agreement is a proxy; strength remains unverified until a controlled ladder intervention.
The ranker still acts one decision at a time; explicit opponent-response search is deferred until a branch-sensitive H2 value model passes offline gates.
AlphaTCG's reported 0.750 high-band mirror result contains only eight games.
description: v25 challenger: compact AlphaTCG-conditioned ranker on the stable v22 runtime.
